tf.s: 'Homesick' describes a feeling of missing home.
'Cope with' means deal successfully with a difficult situation.
tf.why: New students learn to cope with change.

tf.s: 'By the time he arrived, we had left' uses the past perfect.
A 'deadline' is a place on the campus.
tf.why: A deadline is the last time to finish work.

tf.s: To 'edit' writing means to check and correct it.
A 'campus' is a type of test.
tf.why: A campus is the university's grounds and buildings.

tf.s: The past perfect of 'plan' is 'had planed'.
A placement test finds your level.
tf.why: It puts you in the right level.
